caption: The drawing depicts a rectangular woven textile centrally placed against a plain beige background. The textile features a symmetrical geometric design composed of zigzag and diamond patterns. The main colors used are black, white, light blue, red, orange, pink, light yellow, and purple. The borders of the textile are black, and inside there are repeated chevrons and triangular shapes arranged in horizontal rows. In the central portion, horizontal bands alternate between rows of sharp, triangle-like forms in colors such as red, orange, blue, and white. There are three prominent diamond shapes positioned in the top, middle, and bottom thirds of the textile, each filled with smaller diamonds and zigzag patterns in the same color palette. The weaving appears to be detailed and the edges are irregular, reflecting the handmade nature of the object.
title: Textile
cluster: #12 — Spanish Colonial Art of the Southwest
